label: Straight Hem
description: The Straight hem runs at an even, level height all the way around the shirt bottom, with a small vent at each side seam for freedom of movement. It is the preferred hem for shirts designed to be worn untucked — the clean horizontal line creates a polished, deliberate silhouette that avoids the rumpled droop of a round hem worn loose. On casual and resort shirts, a straight hem signals that the garment was designed from the outset to be worn outside the trousers.
